line.s_guests.text: Three little hedgehogs are coming for a snack. Each one gets an apple.

line.s_fox_has.text: I have two apples in my basket.

line.s_naive.text: So together we have two! Mine are more, so mine count.

line.s_not.text: Nothing vanishes! When we put the apples together, there are more than two.

line.s_how.text: Then how many do we have together?

line.s_add.text: We add! We put two piles into one and count them all.

line.s_show.text: I will show you, it is easy. Drag my apple into Fox's basket.

line.s_count_all.text: Now count all the apples in the basket.

line.s_three.text: Three! Two and one more make three.

line.s_write.text: Adding can be written down. Two, plus, one, equals three.

line.s_plus.text: Plus looks like a little cross. It tells us: put them together.

line.s_solved.text: Three apples for three hedgehogs! Enough for everyone.

line.s_to_meadow.text: Let's go to the lake, for a picnic.

line.b_picnic.text: I am putting cups on the blanket. I have two cups.

line.b_owl.text: I have two as well. Drag my cups onto the blanket.

line.b_count.text: Count all the cups on the blanket.

line.b_pick.text: How many are there together? Point to the digit.

line.b_to_home.text: Four cups! Let's go home, I'll bake cookies.

line.c_owl.text: And I baked two. Drag my cookies onto the plate.

line.c_slot.text: Three plus two equals what? Point to the digit that fits at the end.

line.c_solved.text: Now you can add! We put things together and count them all.

line.wrong_digit.text: That is another digit. Count again.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play adding! Two piles, and a plus between them.

line.p_together.text: How many are there together? Point to the digit.

line.a_game.text: Let's play adding toys, just like at home.

line.a_ok.text: All right! We put the toys in the box and count them all.

line.a_put.text: Drag the toys into the box, then count them all.

line.a_which_digit.text: How many are there together? Point to the digit.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to play adding with you. How many spoons will there be when you add one more?
